title: qa(checklist): re-point three stale clauses from the 18.4.0 acceptance (#32940): actions two-holder 409, flow bare-name, co-owner install door
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

QA-source: #32940 · platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal · acceptance[2]
QA-source: #32940 · api-backend.actions-namespace-address · acceptance[1]
QA-source: #32940 · platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · acceptance[1]

Re-point card from the 18.4.0 release acceptance (wave anchor #32908), `main` @ `5fb79bc0`. Each clause below pins a shape that a later landed change replaced (SKILL §5, stale spec); the product behaves as its current contract says. Full evidence: QA run #32940, F-7, F-9, F-10, and its R4 / R5 comments. Fix in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` with a `revision` bump and a `history` row citing the ruling.

1. **api-backend.actions-namespace-address r2, clause 1 and negative 3.** A bare `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION/ID` when two packages hold the action on one object now answers **409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT** naming both packages (#31697 landed; ruling record 6729825528, letter A; `pickActionHolder` in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`). The clause still expects the embedding package's result, and negative 3 still calls the refusal unlanded. Re-point both to the 409.
2. **platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal r2, clauses 1 and 4.** `flow` joined the namespace-scoped bare-name types (#31696, `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`), so a second package in another namespace may hold flow `qa_sync` (install 200), and the bare address answers 409 naming both. Clause 4's cold-restart warning then has no clash to report. Re-point both clauses at a covered type that is still one-holder.
3. **platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal r2, clause 2.** The install door never reaches the co-owner refusal: without a dependency the namespace-ownership rule answers first (422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED "namespace "qa_n" is already owned by …"), with one ADR-0146 D2 answers (403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE naming page/qa_board and both packages). Nothing installs either way. Re-point the clause at the gate that actually answers, or drop the install-door leg and keep the CLI and registry legs.
